text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the approval of parking for a maximum period of one-hour, in effect from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Wolverleigh Boulevard, between Monarch Park Avenue and Coxwell Avenue. The proposed amendment will discourage long-term daytime parking, and increase parking turnover on this section of Wolverleigh Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the Item until its February 23, 2023 meeting.
